podcast.title: Catching Up with an Old Memory (Release)
podcast.body: One of his newest releases sounds very rock in its musical style, despite having country lyrics. This contrasts with his earlier expressed views on the purity of country music. "one of his newest releases catching up with an old memory sounds very rock even if the lyrics are country."

podcast.title: Disdain for Rockers in Country
podcast.body: In 2015, Walker expressed strong disapproval of "outdated rock and rollers" entering country music, arguing that the genre had great singers and musicians and should not be diluted. This sentiment was shared even though Walker himself was born in 1969, suggesting a potential ongoing "culture war" within music. "I can't stand to see the outdated rock and rollers coming in to play country music. It really pisses me off."
